about: What each stylesheet module.json serves may hold, held by tools/css-lint.mjs (node tools/check.mjs css) and, at most, by the suite's R1311 (E44 C1b, 04.11.2026; audit S17-35). Per sheet: `important` (each `!important`), `colourLiterals` (each declaration that is not a custom property and holds a hex, rgb(a)() or hsl(a)() colour), `duplicates` (a rule written again with the same selector list and declarations under the same at-rules) and `deadClasses` (R2's: a `.drpg-*` the sheets style that no script writes); a stray comment end has no budget, it is 0. A count above its budget fails: a rule added one. A count below fails until the budget is lowered in the same commit, so the budget only falls. The rows are written by `node tools/css-lint.mjs --write`, which lowers a row to its count and never raises one, from a run, never by hand.
